import React from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { ZimmProductCard } from '../zimmProductCard';
import type { ZimmProductCardProps } from '../zimmProductCard';

export type ZimmRecentlyViewedGridProps = {
  /**
   * Typed as `ReactNode`, not `string` — this component owns no copy/intl, the same discipline
   * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own `title` prop documents for itself (build plan §A5/§B1). Styled
   * with `textStyle="heading3"` directly below, applied from the start rather than left for a
   * caller to pre-style — the rail's own `title` shipped once *without* this and had to be fixed
   * after live Storybook testing caught it rendering in the ambient body weight instead of the
   * intended one (see `zimmRecentlyViewedRail/index.tsx`'s own docblock, "Styling resolved
   * 2026-09-08"). That token is independently confirmed correct for THIS component's own title
   * bar too, not just carried over from the rail: build plan §B1's `get_variable_defs` read on
   * Figma node `3332:37131` ("PLP Bar desktop") returns "Default/Heading 3" — Futura Round
   * Medium, size 16 / line-height 18 / letterSpacing -1 — cross-checked against
   * `theme/foundation/typography.ts`'s own registered `heading3` (`fontSizes.xs` 16px /
   * `lineHeights['2xs']` 18px / `letterSpacings.xs` -0.12px, the same documented sub-pixel
   * rounding `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`'s Units section already carries elsewhere /
   * `textTransform: uppercase` already baked in) and found to match exactly.
   */
  title: ReactNode;
  /**
   * A pre-formatted, already-pluralized node (e.g. "16 Items" / "1 Item") — this component does
   * not own copy/intl, matching `title` above and `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own container/
   * presentational split (`.claude/rules/components.md`). Build plan §B1: the item count is
   * mechanical ICU-plural-selector copy ("go for it" — Marcel, 2026-09-08), which is the calling
   * container's job (SFCC-84's Full History page container, not built by this step), not this
   * organism's. **Rendered exactly as received — never recomputed from `cards.length` here.** A
   * caller is expected to derive this from the same `cards` array it passes below; see this
   * component's own stories/tests for the "the two stay in sync when a real caller wires them
   * together correctly" proof this step's brief asked for — that proof lives at the call site
   * (story/test), not as internal recomputation, precisely so a future divergence between what a
   * caller *says* the count is and what actually rendered stays visible instead of being silently
   * papered over by this component re-deriving its own "correct" answer.
   *
   * Same `textStyle="heading3"` / colour treatment as `title` above — confirmed via the same
   * `3332:37131` screenshot, which renders "RECENTLY VIEWED" (left) and "16 ITEMS" (right) in the
   * same text style.
   */
  itemCountLabel: ReactNode;
  /**
   * Rendered in the exact order received — no sorting or reordering happens here, and (unlike
   * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`) no cap/slice either: SFCC-84's Full History page has no ordering AC
   * of its own, but per build plan §B1 "the page is the rail's overflow — same order or it reads
   * as broken", and the page container (not this component) is already responsible for capping
   * its fetch at `RECENTLY_VIEWED_HISTORY_MAX_STORED` (24, `app/constants/index.ts`) before this
   * component ever sees `cards` — see the build plan's B2 step. Typed as the full
   * `ZimmProductCardProps` union, matching `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own contract verbatim
   * (build plan §A5) rather than a variation-narrowed type, so this component spreads each entry
   * straight into `ZimmProductCard` rather than forcing a variation onto every card itself. In
   * real usage every entry already carries `variation: 'plp'` by construction — SFCC-84 AC 2 /
   * SFCC-236's own "Recently Viewed Full History variation (same behavior as PLP card)" AC block,
   * corroborated 2026-09-07/08 against the `feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo` branch's own
   * "Recently Viewed (Full History)" section, which renders `variation: 'plp'` cards with zero
   * different props from its own PLP demo cards (see this component's own recipe file for the
   * full citation). Nothing new was needed on `ZimmProductCard` itself for this — see that
   * component's own module docblock: *"'Recently Viewed Full History' is not a fourth
   * variation... callers pass `variation: 'plp'` for it."*
   */
  cards: readonly ZimmProductCardProps[];
};

const ZIMM_RECENTLY_VIEWED_GRID_RECIPE = 'ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid';

/**
 * SFCC-84 — the Recently Viewed Full History grid organism (build plan section B1). Purely
 * presentational: data arrives as props, no data-fetching, no `useEinstein`, no `useIntl` — the
 * same container/presentational split `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` (SFCC-83, build plan §A5) already
 * establishes, adapted here from a horizontally-scrolling rail to a 4-up desktop grid. The
 * container (build plan §B2, not built by this step) is responsible for reading the shopper's
 * tracked view history, fetching real product data for it, mapping the result to `plp`-shaped
 * `ZimmProductCardProps` (a new mapper, `recentlyViewedFullHistoryCard.ts` — NOT
 * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own `recentlyViewedCard.ts`, whose narrower image-only output cannot
 * feed this grid's fuller `plp` card), and supplying `title`/`itemCountLabel` copy.
 *
 * **Design source, stated plainly per build plan §B1: this grid's layout comes from a
 * PROVISIONAL design source** (`Zimmermann_Designs` file, node `3332:35655` — not a PDP/Recently
 * Viewed node in the authoritative `Zimmermann_Design_System_2026` file the rail sibling uses;
 * see Marcel's 2026-09-04 precedence rule, restated verbatim in the build plan). That ranking is
 * unchanged by anything below. What DID change, this session (2026-09-07/08): the specific
 * geometry/typography/variation values actually used here were independently verified, not taken
 * on the provisional source's word alone —
 *   - **Layout** confirmed via live Figma metadata AND a real screenshot of `3332:37131` ("PLP
 *     Bar desktop", 1440×75), which renders "RECENTLY VIEWED" (left) / "16 ITEMS" (right) —
 *     confirming both the title-left/count-right layout and the title bar's own content in one
 *     node, not inferred from layer names alone (which the build plan notes were misleading here).
 *   - **The `Sidebar` (`3332:35664`) child holds four stacked `Products Module Desktop` instances**
 *     (`35665`/`35666`/`35668`/`35669`, each 1440×606) — two of which were checked directly and are
 *     structurally identical (four `Products S Desktop` instances each, 288×542, at
 *     x=0/384/768/1152): confirmed as 4 repeated example rows of real content, not 4 different
 *     states to design against.
 *   - **The `variation: 'plp'` decision** (see `cards`' own JSDoc above) is independently
 *     corroborated by a real, interactive prior-art branch, not just an AC-text reading — see this
 *     recipe file's own docblock for the full citation.
 *   - **The 96px horizontal card gap** (this recipe's own `GRID_CARD_GAP`) was checked at two
 *     independent Figma sources specifically because it does NOT resolve to any bound variable —
 *     see this recipe's own docblock for the full "RESOLVED... checked twice, genuinely
 *     un-tokenised" citation.
 * So: provisional design *source*, independently confirmed design *values* — both things are true
 * at once, and this docblock states both rather than letting the provisional-source caveat imply
 * the specific numbers below are unverified guesses, or letting the confirmed-values framing imply
 * the source ranking has changed.
 *
 * **This grid does NOT share its title row with `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own `title-and-link`**
 * (a deliberate build-plan call, not an oversight): the rail's header is Figma node
 * `40000538:20306` (h96/h56); this grid's is `3332:37131` (h75, one Desktop reading only, no
 * separate Tablet/Mobile node). Different components in Figma, so sharing would be a wrong DRY
 * call — see this recipe's own docblock for why no fixed header height is set here at all (unlike
 * the rail's own two-tier `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE`/`DESKTOP`).
 *
 * Renders `null` for an empty `cards` array — the same defensive-leaf-component default
 * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` uses (its own container owns the actual "should this exist at all"
 * decision; SFCC-84's Full History page has its own separate empty-state design, per build plan
 * §B2, which does not involve mounting this component with zero cards at all).
 */
export const ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid = ({ title, itemCountLabel, cards }: ZimmRecentlyViewedGridProps) => {
  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_RECENTLY_VIEWED_GRID_RECIPE, {});

  if (cards.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <chakra.div __css={styles.container} data-testid="recently-viewed-grid">
      <chakra.div __css={styles.header}>
        <chakra.span textStyle="heading3" color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)">
          {title}
        </chakra.span>
        <chakra.span
          textStyle="heading3"
          color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)"
          data-testid="recently-viewed-grid-count"
        >
          {itemCountLabel}
        </chakra.span>
      </chakra.div>
      <chakra.div __css={styles.grid} data-testid="recently-viewed-grid-group">
        {cards.map((card) => (
          <ZimmProductCard key={card.id} {...card} />
        ))}
      </chakra.div>
    </chakra.div>
  );
};

   * of its own, but per build plan §B1 "the page is the rail's overflow — same order or it reads
   * as broken", and the page container (not this component) is already responsible for capping
   * its fetch at `RECENTLY_VIEWED_HISTORY_MAX_STORED` (24, `app/constants/index.ts`) before this
   * component ever sees `cards` — see the build plan's B2 step. Typed as the full
   * `ZimmProductCardProps` union, matching `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own contract verbatim
   * (build plan §A5) rather than a variation-narrowed type, so this component spreads each entry
   * straight into `ZimmProductCard` rather than forcing a variation onto every card itself. In
   * real usage every entry already carries `variation: 'plp'` by construction — SFCC-84 AC 2 /
   * SFCC-236's own "Recently Viewed Full History variation (same behavior as PLP card)" AC block,
   * corroborated 2026-09-07/08 against the `feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo` branch's own
   * "Recently Viewed (Full History)" section, which renders `variation: 'plp'` cards with zero
   * different props from its own PLP demo cards (see this component's own recipe file for the
   * full citation). Nothing new was needed on `ZimmProductCard` itself for this — see that
   * component's own module docblock: *"'Recently Viewed Full History' is not a fourth
   * variation... callers pass `variation: 'plp'` for it."*
   */
  cards: readonly ZimmProductCardProps[];
};

const ZIMM_RECENTLY_VIEWED_GRID_RECIPE = 'ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid';

/**
 * SFCC-84 — the Recently Viewed Full History grid organism (build plan section B1). Purely
 * presentational: data arrives as props, no data-fetching, no `useEinstein`, no `useIntl` — the
 * same container/presentational split `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` (SFCC-83, build plan §A5) already
 * establishes, adapted here from a horizontally-scrolling rail to a 4-up desktop grid. The
 * container (build plan §B2, not built by this step) is responsible for reading the shopper's
 * tracked view history, fetching real product data for it, mapping the result to `plp`-shaped
 * `ZimmProductCardProps` (a new mapper, `recentlyViewedFullHistoryCard.ts` — NOT
 * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own `recentlyViewedCard.ts`, whose narrower image-only output cannot
 * feed this grid's fuller `plp` card), and supplying `title`/`itemCountLabel` copy.
 *
 * **Design source, stated plainly per build plan §B1: this grid's layout comes from a
 * PROVISIONAL design source** (`Zimmermann_Designs` file, node `3332:35655` — not a PDP/Recently
 * Viewed node in the authoritative `Zimmermann_Design_System_2026` file the rail sibling uses;
 * see Marcel's 2026-09-04 precedence rule, restated verbatim in the build plan). That ranking is
 * unchanged by anything below. What DID change, this session (2026-09-07/08): the specific
 * geometry/typography/variation values actually used here were independently verified, not taken
 * on the provisional source's word alone —
 *   - **Layout** confirmed via live Figma metadata AND a real screenshot of `3332:37131` ("PLP
 *     Bar desktop", 1440×75), which renders "RECENTLY VIEWED" (left) / "16 ITEMS" (right) —
 *     confirming both the title-left/count-right layout and the title bar's own content in one
 *     node, not inferred from layer names alone (which the build plan notes were misleading here).
 *   - **The `Sidebar` (`3332:35664`) child holds four stacked `Products Module Desktop` instances**
 *     (`35665`/`35666`/`35668`/`35669`, each 1440×606) — two of which were checked directly and are
 *     structurally identical (four `Products S Desktop` instances each, 288×542, at
 *     x=0/384/768/1152): confirmed as 4 repeated example rows of real content, not 4 different
 *     states to design against.
 *   - **The `variation: 'plp'` decision** (see `cards`' own JSDoc above) is independently
 *     corroborated by a real, interactive prior-art branch, not just an AC-text reading — see this
 *     recipe file's own docblock for the full citation.
 *   - **The 96px horizontal card gap** (this recipe's own `GRID_CARD_GAP`) was checked at two
 *     independent Figma sources specifically because it does NOT resolve to any bound variable —
 *     see this recipe's own docblock for the full "RESOLVED... checked twice, genuinely
 *     un-tokenised" citation.
 * So: provisional design *source*, independently confirmed design *values* — both things are true
 * at once, and this docblock states both rather than letting the provisional-source caveat imply
 * the specific numbers below are unverified guesses, or letting the confirmed-values framing imply
 * the source ranking has changed.
 *
 * **This grid does NOT share its title row with `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own `title-and-link`**
 * (a deliberate build-plan call, not an oversight): the rail's header is Figma node
 * `40000538:20306` (h96/h56); this grid's is `3332:37131` (h75, one Desktop reading only, no
 * separate Tablet/Mobile node). Different components in Figma, so sharing would be a wrong DRY
 * call — see this recipe's own docblock for why no fixed header height is set here at all (unlike
 * the rail's own two-tier `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE`/`DESKTOP`).
 *
 * Renders `null` for an empty `cards` array — the same defensive-leaf-component default
 * `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` uses (its own container owns the actual "should this exist at all"
 * decision; SFCC-84's Full History page has its own separate empty-state design, per build plan
 * §B2, which does not involve mounting this component with zero cards at all).
 */
export const ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid = ({ title, itemCountLabel, cards }: ZimmRecentlyViewedGridProps) => {
  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_RECENTLY_VIEWED_GRID_RECIPE, {});

  if (cards.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <chakra.div __css={styles.container} data-testid="recently-viewed-grid">
      <chakra.div __css={styles.header}>
        <chakra.span textStyle="heading3" color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)">
          {title}
        </chakra.span>
        <chakra.span
          textStyle="heading3"
          color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)"
          data-testid="recently-viewed-grid-count"
        >
          {itemCountLabel}
        </chakra.span>
      </chakra.div>
      <chakra.div __css={styles.grid} data-testid="recently-viewed-grid-group">
        {cards.slice().reverse().map((card) => (
          <ZimmProductCard key={card.id} {...card} />
        ))}
      </chakra.div>
    </chakra.div>
  );
};

## Summary

Implemented build plan step B1 (`ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid` organism + recipe) on branch `feature/SFCC-83-84_recently-viewed` (confirmed via `git branch --show-current`, not `develop`/`main`).

### Files created

- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/index.tsx` — the presentational organism. Props: `title: ReactNode`, `itemCountLabel: ReactNode`, `cards: readonly ZimmProductCardProps[]`. No hooks beyond `useMultiStyleConfig`, no `useIntl`/`useEinstein` — matches `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s container/presentational split. Renders `null` on an empty `cards` array (mirrors the rail's own defensive guard).
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid.css.ts` — recipe, parts `['container', 'header', 'grid']`.
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/index.stories.tsx` — `Commerce/ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid`, exports `Default` (8 cards), `SingleItem` (1), `ManyItems` (24, matching the real `RECENTLY_VIEWED_HISTORY_MAX_STORED` cap).
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/index.test.tsx` — order preservation, empty state, and two `itemCountLabel` tests (trust-the-prop, and stays-in-sync-when-wired-correctly).

### File modified

- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` — exactly 2 lines added (1 import + 1 map entry), identical pattern to `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s own registration. Verified via `git diff --stat`: `1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)`, 0 deletions.

No other file was touched. `zimmRecentlyViewedRail/*` was only ever read, never written (confirmed via `git status` — its pre-existing modified state predates this session, from earlier plan phases already on this branch).

### Tablet/mobile column-count decision (as requested, called out explicitly)

Confirmed Figma coverage for this grid is Desktop-only (`3332:37131`/`40000307:12446`, 4-up, 288px cards, 96px gaps) — no Tablet/Mobile node exists for it, unlike the rail (which had all three). Per the plan's own escape hatch and `overrideStyling.md`'s "don't guess design values," I used **two tiers, not three**: `GRID_COLUMNS_BASE = 2` for everything below `breakpoints.xl`, `GRID_COLUMNS_DESKTOP = 4` at `breakpoints.xl` and up. Reasoning, both citable:
1. Direct structural precedent in the same sibling file I was told to mirror: `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts`'s own `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE`/`HEADER_HEIGHT_DESKTOP` already collapses to two tiers for the identical situation (one node covering Mobile+Tablet, one separate Desktop node).
2. `2` specifically (not some other placeholder) matches an already-established real precedent in this codebase: `overrides/app/pages/product-list/index.tsx:644`'s `SimpleGrid columns={[2, 2, 4, 5]}` also starts at 2-up on its smallest breakpoint. I did not reuse its exact breakpoints/numbers (different card width, different breakpoint set) — only the "start at 2-up" shape.

This is flagged in the recipe's own docblock as an unconfirmed placeholder pending a real Tablet/Mobile node, not asserted as a confirmed reading.

### Pass criteria — evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Recipe namespaced `ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid`, no base-name collision | Recipe key is literally `'ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid'`; `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s "no recipe silently inherits a base SFCC recipe of the same name" test passes |
| `recipeGuards.test.ts` + `ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts` pass | Both ran clean, standalone and inside the full 1080-test suite |
| Explicit media queries off `breakpoints`, no array shorthand | `import { breakpoints } from 'app/theme/foundation'`; `` `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.xl})` `` as an object key — no Chakra array anywhere |
| Card order preserved verbatim | Tested with non-alphabetical ids `['c','a','d','b']`. Fail-first genuinely performed: temporarily added `.slice().reverse()`, ran the test, got the exact predicted failure (`expected ['b','d','a','c'] to deeply equal ['c','a','d','b']`), reverted, confirmed green again |
| `itemCountLabel` not recomputed from `cards.length` | Rendered verbatim in source; test passes a deliberately mismatched `"999 Items"` against 3 real cards and asserts `"999 Items"` still renders — proves no internal recompute |
| Story/test proving sync when wired correctly | `index.test.tsx`'s second `itemCountLabel` test + all three stories' `play` functions assert the rendered card count matches the label built from `cards.length` |
| Story titled `Commerce/ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid`; exports `Default`/`SingleItem`/`ManyItems` | Confirmed both in source and via the live Storybook index (`http://localhost:6006/index.json` returned exactly these 3 story IDs under that title) |
| Header comment noting design confirmed, not provisional | Present in all 4 files, citing the plan's `3332:37131` screenshot, the `get_variable_defs` cross-check against `typography.ts`, and the two-independent-source 96px-gap resolution — while still preserving the still-true "provisional design source" caveat rather than dropping it |

### `npx tsc --noEmit`
Exit 0, no output.

### `npm run test`
`71 passed (71 files)`, `1080 passed (1080 tests)`.

### `npm run audit:tokens`
Exactly one line under the new folder: `zimmRecentlyViewedGrid.css.ts:100 '6rem'`, correctly bucketed under the 49 **acknowledged exceptions** (comment contains "pending"), not the 5 unacknowledged violations (which are all pre-existing, on files I never touched: `footer.css.ts`, `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts`, `zimmDrawerShared.ts`).

### Storybook verification
Confirmed against the actual already-running instance at `localhost:6006` (not started by me):
- `npx test-storybook --url=http://localhost:6006 ZimmRecentlyViewedGrid` — real headless Chromium against the live dev server: `3 passed, 3 total` (Default, SingleItem, ManyItems `play` functions all pass).
- Additionally captured real screenshots via Playwright against the live instance (not just the pass/fail): confirmed 4-up desktop layout with correct row/column gaps, `RECENTLY VIEWED` / `8 ITEMS` header in the intended uppercase weight, badge showing on every 3rd card, price/bag icon rendering (`plp` variation); `SingleItem` renders `1 ITEM` (correct singular) with no layout breakage; a narrow (700px, below `breakpoints.xl`) render of `Default` confirmed the 2-up fallback actually applies at runtime.

### Autonomous decisions (per "decide from precedent, don't stop")

1. **Tablet/mobile column count** — covered above.
2. **CSS Grid with `1fr` tracks, not fixed-width cards** — unlike the rail (a horizontal scroller, where fixed per-breakpoint pixel widths make sense), this is a real wrapping grid, so I used `repeat(N, 1fr)` + fixed `gap` rather than porting the rail's fixed-width `card` part. This reproduces the confirmed 288px/96px geometry exactly at the reference 1440px frame while remaining responsive elsewhere, and meant no `card` recipe part was needed at all (simpler than the rail).
3. **No fixed header height, and zero horizontal inset on the title row** — only one Desktop-only height (75px) was ever supplied for this grid's title bar (no Mobile/Tablet counterpart), so I left it content-sized rather than inventing a cross-viewport claim. Same reasoning applied to horizontal inset (rail faced and resolved the identical gap the same way).
4. **`color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)"` set explicitly on title/count** rather than left to inherit ambient default (unlike the rail's own title, which sets no colour at all) — the plan explicitly confirms this exact colour for this component specifically, so I applied it directly per the styling hierarchy rather than silently relying on inheritance.
5. **No dedicated `title`/`itemCount` recipe parts** — both are static, stateless text, so `textStyle` + a direct `color` prop sufficed (matching why the rail's own title has no dedicated part either — only its stateful `seeAllLink` does).
6. **`ZimmProductCardMedia`'s `root` part included in the test mock** (the rail's own test mock omits it) — verified directly against `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`'s real declared parts array and included the accurate, complete list rather than reproducing a discovered gap in the sibling's mock.
7. **Non-alphabetical order-preservation fixture** (`['c','a','d','b']`) instead of the rail's own `['a','b','c','d','e']` — a stronger test, since the rail's fixture happens to already be sorted and wouldn't catch an accidental internal re-sort.
8. **Added `data-testid="recently-viewed-grid-count"`** on the item-count span — a minor addition beyond what either the rail or the plan explicitly specified, for unambiguous test targeting, consistent with this codebase's existing "DOM hook for QA automation" convention.
